critical_steps: Self-adjointness gives -R I <= S_Theta-S_Lambda <= R I.
Combining with A I <= S_Lambda <= B I gives the corrected bounds A-R and B+R.
One-point scalar systems attain each corrected endpoint exactly.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact one-dimensional counterexample plus a self-adjoint operator-order argument.
integrity.unproved_limits: No finer family-specific perturbation bound using additional spectral information is classified.

limitations: The correction applies to the frame-operator-difference corollary, not to the separate analysis-operator perturbation theorem.
The constants A-R and B+R are sharp universal constants from the stated A, B, R data; individual families may admit better bounds.
No claim is made about perturbation models that use different norms or coefficient-level hypotheses.

title: The sharp frame-operator perturbation bound is \(B+R\), not \(R+\sqrt B\)
